Club Kits
Key Answer

MOMUTO offers three ways to create a fully custom football kit for your club: design it yourself in real time with the 3D configurator, submit a brief and get a free professional mockup in 1–2 days, or send an AI-generated concept and our designers make it production-ready. No minimum order, design always free, delivery in 25–30 days worldwide.

Why Your Club Deserves a Custom Kit

A shared kit does more than identify players on the pitch — it builds the sense of belonging that keeps a club together season after season. When every player pulls on the same shirt before a match, the visual signal is immediate: this is a team, not a group of individuals in similar colours.

Generic or off-the-shelf kits can't deliver that. The crest is an afterthought, the colours are a compromise, and the design belongs to a template used by dozens of other clubs. A custom kit — one built around your club's actual identity — changes that entirely.

Three Ways to Get Your MOMUTO Kit

1. Real-Time 3D Configurator

Design your kit directly on momuto.com using 30+ professional templates. Adjust colours, apply your badge, add names and numbers, and place your order — all without waiting for a designer. The configurator shows the finished result in real time, so what you see is exactly what you get.

2. Free Professional Design Service

Prefer to hand the design work to someone else? Submit your brief — club colours, badge, any visual references — and our design team delivers a custom mockup within 1–2 business days. Revisions are unlimited and the service is completely free, regardless of whether you order.

3. AI Concept to Real Kit

Created a kit concept using ChatGPT, Midjourney, or another AI tool? Send it to MOMUTO. Our designers translate the image into a production-ready, wearable kit — preserving your vision while adapting it to real fabric and printing constraints. No other supplier offers this route.

Benefits for Clubs Ordering Together

MOMUTO is built around the way clubs actually order. A few things worth knowing before you start:

  • No minimum order — order one kit for a trialist or 100+ for a full squad. The process is the same either way.
  • Quantity discounts — the per-jersey price drops significantly as squad size grows. From €38.90 for a single jersey to €20.90/jersey for orders of 10 or more.
  • Consistent branding across the club — first team, youth teams, training kits and staff — all built from the same design, ensuring visual coherence across every squad.
  • Design always free — whether you use the configurator, the free design service, or send an AI concept, there is no design fee at any stage.

How to Design Your Kit in the 3D Configurator — Step by Step

The configurator is the fastest way to go from idea to order. Here's how each step works.

Step 1 — Choose a Template

Start by browsing the template library. There are 30+ base designs covering classic, modern, striped, and geometric styles. Select the one that best fits your club's aesthetic — you'll customise everything from here.

Step 2 — Set Your Colours and Patterns

Apply your primary and secondary club colours. The configurator updates the 3D preview in real time, so you can test colour combinations instantly and switch until the balance looks right.

Step 3 — Upload Your Club Badge and Sponsor Logos

Upload your badge as a PNG or SVG and position it on the chest. If you have a sleeve sponsor or back-of-shirt logo, add those too. The configurator handles standard badge placement automatically, or you can drag to reposition.

Step 4 — Add Player Names and Numbers

Choose your font, size, and placement for the name and number. You can preview how the full personalisation looks on the 3D model before committing. Individual player names and numbers are applied per unit at the order stage.

Step 5 — Select Sizes and Quantities

Enter the size breakdown for your squad. MOMUTO offers the full size range — from youth XS through adult 4XL — so mixed squads can be handled in a single order. Quantity discounts apply automatically as you add units.

Step 6 — Add to Cart and Place Your Order

Once your design and size split are confirmed, add to cart and complete checkout. Production begins once payment is received. Delivery is 25–30 days worldwide.

Not Sure Where to Start?

Skip the configurator and let our designers handle it. Send your club colours, badge, and any references — and get a custom mockup back in 1–2 business days. Free, with unlimited revisions.

REQUEST FREE DESIGN

Tips for a Great Club Kit Design

Stick to two or three colours. The most recognisable club kits in the world rely on a tight palette. Adding too many colours dilutes the visual identity rather than strengthening it.

Make your badge the focal point. Full dye-sublimation printing means your crest can be reproduced at full detail and colour accuracy — don't reduce it to a small chest patch. Give it space.

Test the away kit at the same time. Designing home and away together ensures they contrast properly and share the same typographic style. It also simplifies reorders as your squad grows.
